name: Drone Synth Styles
author: Freek van Gool
description: Drones, pads, textures and rhythmic root patterns for Drone Synth in ten styles: Drone, Ambient, Dark Ambient, Techno, Industrial, Cinematic, Meditation, Sci-Fi, Doom and Minimal. Flat tunes sound on their own (hold is on); pattern tunes carry a root sequence and need the transport.
